messages:
maria: Quick sync  release week coordination. Marketing needs final public changelog URL, canonical docs link, a one-line benchmark blurb for hero, webinar CTA copy, and the exact canary start so we can schedule the mailer and social. @aj @noah @sara @ops-lead

aj: Changelog is published: https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-12-release. Still adding a short appendix with bench artifacts but link is stable.

noah: Docs landing ready; canonical will be https://docs.redwood.inference/releases/2026-12 once ops flips. I added a short "what to expect" note about the canary at the top.

eng-docs: Minor redirect note: we'll flip the staging redirect to canonical at 08:30 PT. Please avoid linking the preview URL in press.

ops-lead: Rollout plan: 08:40 PT 10% for 15m, 30% for 20m, full at 09:15 PT. Rollback triggers: p95 > 280ms or error rate > 1% sustained 3m. I'll orchestrate and watch.

sara: CTA locked: "Join our 12/10 webinar to see the benchmarks". Hero blurb (one-liner): "Up to 2.8x faster p95 generation and meaningful cost savings on typical chat workloads." Keeping it clear and linkable to the appendix.

sales-sd: For lead routing: landing path should be /r/dec_release and utm_campaign=dec_release. Segment event name: "release_dec_signup". Can you post sample webhook payload for SDRs?

noah: Sample payload (for webhooks/segments):
```json
{"event":"release_dec_signup","source":"announce_email","campaign":"dec_release"}
```
We'll also add the snippet to the landing page.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect job queued for 2026-12-10T16:30:00Z (08:30 PT). canary-rollout job queued for 2026-12-10T16:40:00Z (08:40 PT). Monitoring hooks: perf-alerts, error-rate, rollout-audit.

maria: Solid. Marketing will schedule email for 09:45 PT and social at 10:00 PT only if canary is green by 09:25 PT. Last asks: - confirm changelog link (aj done) - confirm docs canonical live at 08:30 PT (eng-docs/ops) - confirm CTA and blurb (sara done) - confirm Segment payload (noah done)

ops-lead: Confirmed. I'll post canary progress and escalate if thresholds breached.

aj: Confirmed changelog. I'll add the bench artifact link in the footer of the email template.

sara: I'll post final email subject and hero copy by 15:00 PT. Proposed subject: "Redwood Inference: faster, cheaper LLM serving".

eng-docs: Docs redirect scheduled; I'll monitor and validate canonical landing after flip.

maria: Thanks team  locking send window. If anything slips, update this thread and tag @maria. :rocket:
